title: Your First Weekend at Austin College, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Check In at Mabee Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Start your weekend by picking up orientation materials and your ID at the Wright Campus Center. This is the central hub for all new student information.
cards.short_summary: The primary check-in point for new students to receive orientation packets and IDs.
cards.evidence_claim: New student check-in and information pickup occurs at the Wright Campus Center, Mabee Hall, from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM on the first Friday of orientation.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Fall 2026 Orientation Schedule - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open to new students and families during scheduled orientation hours.

cards.title: Stock Up on Essentials
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Errands
cards.notes: Visit the first floor of the Wright Campus Center to grab snacks and room essentials using your newly activated Hopper Dollars.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store for snacks, beverages, and sundry items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hopper Store, located on the first floor of the Wright Campus Center, sells snacks and sundries and accepts Hopper Dollars.
cards.source_title: Kangaroo Coffee Company & Hopper Store | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Standard weekday hours are typically 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

cards.title: The Freshman Class Photo
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Tradition
cards.notes: Join your peers at the fountains for the traditional class photo. It is one of the first official group activities for the incoming class.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark used for the traditional freshman class group photograph.
cards.evidence_claim: The freshman class photo is a tradition held at the Williams Graduation Fountains on the Saturday morning of orientation weekend.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Fall 2026 Orientation Schedule - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space; photo event is scheduled for 8:45 AM.

cards.title: First Meal at the Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Saturday Lunch Break
cards.notes: Head to the Wright Campus Center Dining Hall to use your meal plan for the first time and meet other students in a casual setting.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall offering all-you-care-to-eat meals.
cards.evidence_claim: The main dining hall, known as 'The Caf,' is located in the Wright Campus Center and serves lunch from noon to 1:00 PM on orientation Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Requires a meal plan swipe or cash/credit payment.

cards.title: New 'Roo Evening on the Green
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Social
cards.notes: Gather on the central campus lawn for an evening of community activities designed to help new students bond before classes start.
cards.short_summary: The central lawn of the campus used for major outdoor student social events.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'New Roo Evening on the Green' is a scheduled orientation event held on the College Green from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM on Saturday.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Fall 2026 Orientation Schedule - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; event is specific to new students.

cards.title: Orientation in Nation Theatre
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Session
cards.notes: Attend the 'Belongingness and Community' session to learn about the values and expectations of the Austin College community.
cards.short_summary: A campus facility housing the Nation Theatre, used for orientation presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation sessions such as 'Belongingness and Community' are held in the Ida Green-Nation Theatre on Sunday morning.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Fall 2026 Orientation Schedule - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Indoor theatre; access during scheduled orientation sessions.

cards.title: Caffeine Kick at the WCC
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Recharge
cards.notes: Grab a specialty coffee or tea at this student-favorite spot in the Wright Campus Center while reviewing your class schedule.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee shop located within the Wright Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Kangaroo Coffee Co. is located inside the Wright Campus Center and offers coffee and snacks for students.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular campus dining hours; accepts Hopper Dollars.

cards.title: Locate the 24-Hour Study Room
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Prep
cards.notes: Find the 24-hour study space in the library so you know where to go for late-night academic work throughout the semester.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library featuring a dedicated 24-hour study area for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Abell Library includes a 24-hour study room available for student use.
cards.access_notes: 24-hour access available for the dedicated study room with student ID.

cards.title: Evening Walk at Zauk Circle
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Reflection
cards.notes: Take a quiet walk through the Zauk Circle drive and garden to appreciate the campus landmarks before the first day of classes.
cards.short_summary: A scenic circle drive and garden entrance to the Austin College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Zauk Circle is a drive and garden area that serves as a prominent entrance to the college campus.
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space accessible at all times.

cards.title: Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Kickoff
cards.notes: Attend the formal ceremony that officially opens the academic year. It is a key tradition featuring faculty in full academic regalia.
cards.short_summary: The official ceremony marking the start of the new academic year for all students.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation is held on the Monday before classes begin to kick off the new academic year.
cards.access_notes: Formal event; check the orientation schedule for exact morning start time.
